summary: Two climbers stranded ~160 ft up the First Flatiron near Boulder, unable to descend safely after their climb; a passing climber called 911 and stayed with them; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group ascended above the pair with harnesses, helmets and headlamps and lowered both to the ground; uninjured but shaken
notes: Incident date given in the story ('on October 1, 2024'). Distinct from the spring-2024 Austin Wolff/Susan Katz + cat Link First Flatiron rescue (RMRG, 'Saturday night', ~March/April 2024, date unpinned -- stays a pending lead on the advnture.com roster line). Dedupe: no Boulder 2024-09-28-10-04 rows; no First Flatiron token collisions in 2024.
